SELECT t1.id AS id, t1.`code` AS code, t1.`name` AS name, t1.category_code AS categoryCode, t2.tree_name AS treeName FROM bm_flow_audit AS t1 join bm_flow_audit_category as t2 on t1.category_code = t2.`code` WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 and t2.is_deleted = 0
and t1.category_code in
#{item}
and t1.code like concat('%',#{code},'%')
and t1.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
order by t1.create_time desc
